en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a mountain hut named 'Capanna Spinale' set against a dramatic backdrop of rugged, snow-capped peaks. The building has signage and a small flag, with rocky and grassy terrain in the foreground and towering mountains in the background under a cloudy sky. There is printed text at the bottom, and signs visible on the hut's exterior.
